item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 05/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft now affecting the coast of Guangdong is expected to weaken gradually today and tomorrow. There will be a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China on Sunday and Monday. Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, the weather will be slightly cooler and become brighter gradually over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather over the central part of the Philippines and southern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days.
